title: Government contracts that were really for UAP data, presented as war games

tellings.quote: And I would add that situation is complicated by the fact that in the past we already received contracts from the government to collect data on NAA.

plain: Between 2021 and 2025, a startup that tries to call UFOs to appear says it received government contracts that were really for collecting data on these unexplained objects, though they were presented as war games. James Valor of that company, Skywatcher, says so from his own side of the deal, adding that "in the past we already received contracts from the government to collect data" on them, which would mean the government quietly pays private groups to gather UFO evidence.
